turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of a class and nobody called me first, so start with why.
Before anything, I owe you an apology. I entered the zero without calling you. That was wrong.
Okay. Now show me what you have on the essay.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
Cc: Principal
Date: Tuesday, November 10

Hale,

Thank you for meeting with me today. You acknowledged that you entered Owen's zero on his English 30-1 essay before contacting me, and that this was wrong. You have not yet shown me any evidence supporting the zero.

I expect to receive, in writing and before any further action: the basis for the zero, any documents you hold, and confirmation that nothing has been placed on Owen's record.

Please reply by Thursday, November 12.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Not yet. You still haven't answered me: is there anything in the body of that file, or any earlier sample of Owen's writing?
